text: Our return policy allows returns within 30 days of purchase with a receipt.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.
Warranty covers manufacturing defects for 12 months from the purchase date.
To reset your account password, use the 'Forgot password' link on the sign-in page.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days; express shipping takes 1 to 2 days.
